fairness.current: one prebuilt Plite editor with one commit subscriber; promotion timer surrounds operation replay, transaction finalization, commit construction, and publication
fairness.prototype: one prebuilt JSON token document with one commit subscriber; promotion timer covers ChangeSet construction, immutable apply, minimal before/after/change commit construction, and publication
fairness.serializedReplay: every scenario also reconstructs ChangeSet from toJSON output, applies it, constructs the same minimal commit, publishes it, and must remain under 2x current transaction time
fairness.excluded: React, DOM, history, collaboration, and transaction fields/effects that belong to later rewrite slices
fairness.memoryProxy: serialized retained shapes and token/index unit counts; not process heap

thresholdPolicy.distributionGate: The 2x time gate compares per-lane medians across 40 iterations in each of three runs. p75/p95/p99/max remain diagnostics because independently sampled sub-millisecond tails are dominated by scheduler and garbage-collection outliers; p99 is the maximum at this sample count.
thresholdPolicy.tokenShapeDiagnosticOnly: Explicit open/text/close tokens preserve empty JSON leaves; compact storage belongs to production slice 1.
